# Prompt Enhancement Skill for Muse

A prompt-engineering playbook that turns vague UI ideas ("make me a login page") into precise, structured generation prompts: it checks what's missing (platform, page type, visual style, colors, components), swaps vague wording for concrete UI/UX terms, amplifies the vibe with descriptive adjectives, organizes the page into numbered sections, and formats a design-system block (palette, typography, component styles). It also detects a project's DESIGN.md file to keep multi-screen work visually consistent. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: written for Google's Stitch UI generator (examples and output format reference it), but the enhancement techniques transfer to any AI UI or image generation workflow. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
